description: Test whether the early whitening-bias freeze limits the cheap curriculum. On the tip (E052, or I072's successor if kept), make one change: keep training the whitening-conv bias until the end of the 28 px stage (3.5 epochs, sample 175000) instead of until the end of epoch 1. This needs a 28 px train-step variant WITH whitening-bias grad, compiled and warmed up in build() (full batch and every partial shape at the 1.5- and 3.5-epoch switches), with channels_last tensors in the exact timed layout (E035). The 32 px stage keeps the frozen-bias graph. Lr for the whitening bias follows its existing schedule. Run debug_nan.py on the new graph and compare trial-0 with later-trial train times.
